clauses.scope_note: Licensed Materials may be used only in connection with Databricks Services pursuant to the Agreement, subject to applicable service restrictions and documentation, and solely for use within or connecting to those Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: All predicates are conjunctive. The Agreement and applicable service restrictions and documentation are external dependencies. If the user does not agree to the terms, the paragraph expressly prohibits using the Licensed Materials.

clauses.scope_note: Copying Licensed Materials is limited to the stated Databricks Services purpose and subject to the Agreement, applicable service restrictions, and documentation.
clauses.condition_explanation: All predicates are conjunctive; the Agreement and applicable service restrictions and documentation are not supplied. The paragraph also prohibits copying if the user does not agree to the terms.

clauses.scope_note: Modifying Licensed Materials is limited to the stated Databricks Services purpose and subject to the Agreement, applicable service restrictions, and documentation.
clauses.condition_explanation: All predicates are conjunctive; the Agreement and applicable service restrictions and documentation are not supplied. The paragraph also prohibits modifying if the user does not agree to the terms.

clauses.scope_note: The paragraph permits publishing Licensed Materials solely for use within or connecting to Databricks Services, subject to the Agreement and applicable service restrictions and documentation. Distribute is the closest available activity for publishing.
clauses.condition_explanation: All predicates are conjunctive; the Agreement and applicable service restrictions and documentation are not supplied. The paragraph also prohibits publishing if the user does not agree to the terms.

clauses.scope_note: Redistribution of Licensed Materials is permitted if all use complies with the license terms; additional redistribution duties appear at lines 29–40.
clauses.condition_explanation: all_use_complies_with_license_terms refers to the license terms, including applicable scope limits and the redistribution conditions in this section.

clauses.scope_note: Sublicensing Licensed Materials is permitted if all use complies with the license terms; additional redistribution duties appear at lines 29–40.
clauses.condition_explanation: all_use_complies_with_license_terms refers to the license terms, including applicable scope limits and the redistribution conditions in this section.

clauses.scope_note: When redistributing Licensed Materials, the licensee must give each recipient a copy of this License.
clauses.condition_explanation: The condition is the expressly required recipient-by-recipient delivery of a license copy when redistributing.

obligation_items.content: Give each recipient a copy of this License.
obligation_items.trigger: Each redistribution of Licensed Materials to a recipient.

clauses.scope_note: Redistribution of modified files requires the files to carry prominent notices stating that they were changed.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies to modified files in the redistribution context; each applicable notice must prominently state that the file was changed.

obligation_items.content: Cause each modified file to carry a prominent notice stating that the file was changed.

clauses.scope_note: Distributed derivative works must retain applicable copyright, patent, trademark, and attribution notices. Notices that do not pertain to any part of the derivative work are excluded.
clauses.condition_explanation: The retention condition applies to notices that pertain to any part of the distributed derivative work; nonpertaining notices are excepted.

obligation_items.content: Retain all copyright, patent, trademark, and attribution notices that pertain to any part of the derivative work.
obligation_items.trigger: Distribution of a derivative work; excludes notices that do not pertain to any part of that work.

clauses.scope_note: A distributed derivative work must include a readable copy of pertinent attribution notices from a NOTICE text file only if that file is provided as part of its distribution. Nonpertaining notices are excluded.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both predicates apply: the NOTICE file is provided as part of the distribution, and the included readable attribution notices pertain to some part of the derivative work.

obligation_items.content: Include a readable copy of the attribution notices from the NOTICE text file that pertain to any part of the derivative work.
obligation_items.trigger: A derivative work is distributed and a NOTICE text file is provided as part of its distribution; excludes notices that do not pertain to any part of the derivative work.

clauses.scope_note: The licensee may add a copyright statement to modifications and provide additional license terms for use, reproduction, or distribution of modifications, or for derivative works as a whole, provided use, reproduction, and distribution of Licensed Materials otherwise complies with the license.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission to add a copyright statement or additional terms is conditioned on otherwise complying with the license. Distribute is used for the additional-terms permission; the clause also covers adding a copyright statement, for which no specific activity is available.

clauses.scope_note: The license terminates automatically upon breach or Agreement termination; Databricks may also terminate at any time on notice. Upon termination, the licensee must permanently delete Licensed Materials and all copies. Deletion is not an available activity.
clauses.condition_explanation: Termination triggers are alternatives. Permanent deletion is expressly required upon any termination but cannot be represented with the supplied activity vocabulary.

obligation_items.content: Permanently delete the Licensed Materials and all copies thereof.
obligation_items.trigger: Upon termination of the license, whether automatic upon breach or Agreement termination, or by Databricks on notice.

coverage_notes: The Master Cloud Services Agreement and applicable Databricks Services restrictions and documentation are referenced but not supplied; their requirements cannot be inferred.
The license requires permanent deletion upon termination, but no deletion activity is available, so that operative duty remains unrepresentable.
The source expressly prohibits viewing without agreement, but no view activity is available; this prohibition is not separately modeled.
The disclaimer and limitation of liability are nonoperative for this activity-constraint extraction.

paragraph_audit.reason: Document title and copyright line do not create an activity constraint.
Defines Agreement and points to the external MCSA; the definition is context, not an operative grant or restriction.
Defines Licensed Materials; the definition informs operative clause scope but creates no rule itself.
Captures the service-linked scope, compliance conditions, specified permissions, and non-agreement restriction insofar as available activities permit; viewing cannot be separately represented.
Captures redistribution and sublicensing as separate actions, each conditioned on compliance with the license terms.
Captures recipient license delivery, modified-file notices, applicable notice retention, and the conditional NOTICE-file attribution requirement with their distinct triggers and exceptions.
Captures the permission to add copyright statements and additional license terms, subject to otherwise complying with the license.
Termination triggers are recorded, but the expressly required permanent deletion cannot be represented with the supplied activity vocabulary.
Warranty and liability disclaimers allocate risk but do not create behavioral activity duties for this extraction.
